setting: A remote river crossing (pereprava) in the borderland north of the Wild Fields, high summer 1550: a small wooded ravine, an oak and alder forest edge, a sunlit meadow sloping to a slow river ford fringed with bulrush and sedge; a sloboda of whitewashed thatched huts behind a sharpened oak palisade with a timber gate.

characters.mykhailo: 28-year-old sloboda Cossack trapper, stocky and broad-shouldered, round sunburnt face, short-cropped light brown hair, sandy drooping mustache, light stubble, linen shirt, grey wool svyta, dark green sharovary, knife on a leather belt, worn brown boots, bow case at the hip
characters.chestnut_horse: old chestnut steppe gelding with a flaxen mane, loaded with bundles of fox and marten furs and leather saddlebags
characters.ostap_shchur: 35-year-old renegade Cossack, gaunt and hollow-cheeked, sallow face, shaggy overgrown black forelock, uneven black mustache, black stubble, dirty linen shirt, torn dark-brown svyta, ragged faded red sharovary, leather postoly shoes, linen bag on his back, quiver and bow
characters.patrol: sloboda patrol of three Cossacks in grey and brown svytas, blue sharovary, sheepskin kalpaks, long mustaches, samopals across their backs, small steppe horses
characters.starosta: 60-year-old sloboda elder, white forelock under a black kalpak, long white mustache, heavy brown zhupan, green sash, wooden staff
characters.children: barefoot sloboda children aged 7 to 11 in long linen shirts, sunburnt, tousled hair, wooden slingshots

palette: Passages: sepia and graphite on warm ivory paper, fine organic pen and pencil hatching inspired by Abraham van Westerveld. Cover only: ultra-realistic full-color cinematic photograph.
notes: Mykhailo returns from a lone trapping trip (ukhod) with a horse loaded with furs. The ambusher is Ostap Shchur, a deserter who escaped execution; his identity is revealed only at r.1/31, so earlier images keep his face in shadow or out of frame. The arrow lodges in Mykhailo's left shoulder through the svyta; a shallow cut on his left cheek. All killing is implied: struggle, still bodies seen from behind or covered, no wounds. The severed head is never shown: only a tied linen bundle and a stake on the palisade out of focus or out of frame.
cover_palette: hot green summer meadow, silver river, dark forest edge, bleached sedge; Mykhailo's grey svyta against green; the ambusher's faded red sharovary as the one alarming accent; evening scenes in amber torchlight.
illustration_notes: 22 passage drawings. Mykhailo and Ostap remain distinct. No ambusher before he is revealed; do not resurrect him after his death. Keep branch-specific injuries and equipment. Violence is implied.
